winner.text: Add impression-time request-context categorical features tab, hour, and weekday to the neutral user/item additive scaffold while retaining pointwise BCE.
winner.rationale: Measured screening found request_context lifted primary by 0.002213, with positive movement on all four internal temporal-holdout days. Warm-user/item GAUC was 0.6312 and nDCG@5 was 0.5076, indicating useful within-user discrimination but only moderate top-five concentration. Downside risk: the modest and variable lift may not generalize, and sparse context categories can overfit.
winner.exact_ablation: Add only the impression-time request_context feature group (tab, hour, weekday); leave model, loss, sampler, optimizer, and stopping unchanged.

expected_effect.GAUC: Expected +0.0015 to +0.0040 from context-dependent within-user ordering.
expected_effect.nDCG@5: Expected +0.0005 to +0.0025, potentially smaller than the GAUC gain.

selection_rationale: Select c01 because it has the strongest measured evidence: request_context produced a +0.002213 primary lift with positive movement on all four temporal-holdout days, full coverage, low leakage and runtime risk, and unchanged training settings. It offers a reliable, focused improvement and is the Consultant's top-ranked candidate, despite modest expected gain and some overfitting risk.
